points.title: 早年启蒙
points.description: 提香出生于威尼斯共和国的卡多列地区，这里是他的故乡。他最初的艺术启蒙来自于他的叔叔，一位画家和士兵。大约在1500年左右，提香前往威尼斯，成为著名画家乔凡尼·贝利尼的学徒。在这段时期，他学习了绘画的基础技巧，并开始接触文艺复兴时期的艺术理念。贝利尼工作室是威尼斯艺术的重要中心，提香在这里不仅学习了绘画技巧，还结识了其他年轻艺术家，包括乔尔乔内，这对提香后来的艺术风格产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Titian was born in Cadore, a region in the Republic of Venice. His early artistic启蒙启蒙 came from his uncle, who was both a painter and a soldier. Around 1500, Titian moved to Venice and became an apprentice to the renowned painter Giovanni Bellini. During this period, he learned fundamental painting techniques and was introduced to the artistic ideals of the Renaissance. Bellini's workshop was a significant center of Venetian art, and here Titian not only mastered painting skills but also met other young artists, including Giorgione, whose influence profoundly shaped Titian's later artistic style.

points.title: 风格形成
points.description: 在威尼斯，提香与乔尔乔内合作完成了许多作品，包括著名的《圣母怜子图》等。这一时期，提香开始发展自己独特的艺术风格，融合了威尼斯的色彩传统与佛罗伦萨的构图技巧。1510年左右，乔尔乔内早逝后，提香接手完成了他未完成的作品，这标志着提香艺术生涯的重要转折点。1516年，提香获得了威尼斯共和国的官方画家称号，这使他获得了稳定的社会地位和创作自由。在这一阶段，提香创作了《天上的爱与世俗的爱》等重要作品，展现了他对色彩和光影的精湛掌握。
points.descriptionEn: In Venice, Titian collaborated with Giorgione on numerous works, including the famous 'Pieta'. During this period, Titian began developing his distinctive artistic style, blending Venetian color traditions with Florentine compositional techniques. Around 1510, following Giorgione's early death, Titian completed his unfinished works, marking a significant turning point in his career. In 1516, Titian was appointed as the official painter of the Republic of Venice, granting him stable social status and creative freedom. During this phase, he created masterpieces like 'Sacred and Profane Love', demonstrating his exceptional mastery of color and light.

points.title: 艺术巅峰
points.description: 获得官方画家称号后，提香进入了创作最旺盛的时期。他接受了来自欧洲各地的委托，包括为贵族和教会创作肖像画和宗教题材作品。1530年代，提香创作了《乌尔比诺的维纳斯》等代表作，展现了他对古典主题的独特诠释。同时，他开始为神圣罗马帝国皇帝查理五世创作肖像画，这使他的名声超越了意大利边界。1533年，查理五世授予提香伯爵头衔，使他成为第一位获得贵族身份的画家。这一时期，提香的艺术风格更加成熟，色彩运用更加大胆，人物形象更加生动，对后世巴洛克艺术产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: After being appointed official painter, Titian entered his most productive creative period. He received commissions from across Europe, including portraits and religious works for nobles and the Church. In the 1530s, he created masterpieces like 'Venus of Urbino', showcasing his unique interpretation of classical themes. Simultaneously, he began creating portraits for Holy Roman Emperor Charles V, extending his fame beyond Italy's borders. In 1533, Charles V granted Titian the title of Count, making him the first painter to receive noble status. During this period, Titian's artistic style matured, with more audacious use of color and more lifelike figures, profoundly influencing later Baroque art.

points.title: 欧洲声誉
points.description: 1548年，提香应教皇保罗三世的邀请前往罗马，这是他唯一一次前往这座永恒之城。在罗马期间，他为教皇创作了肖像画，并受到米开朗基罗等艺术大师的认可。虽然提香在罗马停留时间不长，但这次经历极大地提升了他的国际声誉。返回威尼斯后，提香继续为欧洲各地的皇室和贵族创作，包括为西班牙国王菲利普二世创作了一系列神话和宗教题材作品。这一时期，提香的作品风格更加成熟，色彩运用更加大胆，笔触更加自由，形成了独特的'提香风格'，影响了整个欧洲的绘画发展。
points.descriptionEn: In 1548, Titian was invited to Rome by Pope Paul III III, his only visit to the Eternal City. During his stay in Rome, he created portraits for the Pope and received recognition from master artists like Michelangelo. Although Titian's time in Rome was brief, this experience significantly enhanced his international reputation. Returning to Venice, he continued creating works for European royalty and nobility, including a series of mythological and religious paintings for King Philip II of Spain. During this period, Titian's style matured further, with more audacious use of color and freer brushstrokes, forming his distinctive 'Titianesque' style that influenced the development of painting throughout Europe.

points.title: 晚年杰作
points.description: 晚年时期的提香虽然健康状况不佳，但创作力依然旺盛。他继续接受来自欧洲各地的委托，创作了许多重要作品，包括《最后的审判》系列和《皮耶罗·德·美第奇肖像》等。这一时期，提香的作品风格更加自由奔放，色彩运用更加大胆，笔触更加粗犷，展现了他对生命和艺术的深刻理解。1576年，威尼斯爆发瘟疫，提香不幸感染去世，享年约88岁。提香去世后，他的艺术风格对后世画家产生了深远影响，尤其是对鲁本斯、委拉斯开兹等巴洛克大师。提香被认为是威尼斯画派的代表人物，也是文艺复兴时期最重要的画家之一，他的作品至今仍被视为西方艺术的瑰宝。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, despite declining health, Titian remained remarkably productive. He continued receiving commissions from across Europe, creating important works including the 'Last Judgment' series and portraits of Piero de' Medici. During this period, his style became more free and expressive, with bolder color use and rougher brushstrokes, reflecting his profound understanding of life and art. In 1576, Venice was struck by a plague, and Titian died of the infection at approximately 88 years old. After his death, Titian's style profoundly influenced later painters, especially Baroque masters like Rubens and Velázquez. Titian is considered a leading figure of the Venetian school and one of the most important painters of the Renaissance, with his works still regarded as treasures of Western art.

supporter.zh: 提香被艺术史学家誉为'色彩大师'，他的作品代表了威尼斯画派的巅峰成就。他革新了绘画技法，特别是对色彩的运用达到了前所未有的高度，影响了整个巴洛克艺术的发展。提香的作品充满生命力，人物形象生动自然，情感表达深刻。他不仅是一位杰出的画家，还是一位成功的商人，懂得如何经营自己的艺术事业，这在当时的艺术家中是罕见的。提香的艺术遗产跨越了几个世纪，至今仍被世界各地的艺术爱好者所推崇。
supporter.en: Titian is hailed by art historians as the 'master of color', whose works represent the pinnacle of Venetian painting. He revolutionized painting techniques, particularly his unprecedented mastery of color, influencing the development of Baroque art. Titian's works are full of vitality with natural, lifelike figures and profound emotional expression. He was not only an exceptional painter but also a successful businessman who knew how to manage his artistic career, which was rare among artists of his time. Titian's artistic legacy spans centuries and is still revered by art enthusiasts worldwide.

critic.zh: 批评者认为提香的作品有时过于注重色彩效果而牺牲了细节精确性，特别是在晚年作品中。一些艺术评论家指出，提香对宗教题材的处理有时缺乏深度，更多关注形式美感而非精神内涵。此外，提香作为宫廷画家的身份也受到批评，认为他过于迎合贵族和教会的品味，缺乏艺术独立性。他的商业成功也被一些人视为对艺术纯粹性的妥协，认为他将艺术商品化，削弱了艺术的本质价值。
critic.en: Critics argue that Titian's works sometimes prioritized color effects over precise details, particularly in his later paintings. Some art commentators note that his treatment of religious subjects often lacked depth, focusing more on formal beauty than spiritual内涵. Additionally, his status as a court painter has been criticized for allegedly catering too much to the tastes of nobility and the Church, lacking artistic independence. His commercial success has also been seen by some as a compromise on artistic purity, suggesting he commercialized art and diminished its essential value.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，提香被公认为文艺复兴时期最重要的画家之一，与达芬奇、米开朗基罗和拉斐尔齐名。他的艺术成就不仅体现在技术上，更在于他成功融合了威尼斯的色彩传统与意大利其他地区的艺术理念。在流行文化中，提香的作品经常被引用和模仿，他的色彩理论影响了后世无数画家。提香的艺术生涯跨越了文艺复兴盛期和晚期，见证了艺术风格的演变，他的作品因此成为研究这一时期艺术发展的重要资料。尽管存在争议，提香在西方艺术史上的地位无可争议，他的作品至今仍是艺术研究和欣赏的重要对象。
objective.en: In academic circles, Titian is widely recognized as one of the most important painters of the Renaissance period, ranked alongside Leonardo da Vinci, Michelangelo, and Raphael. His artistic achievements are not only technical but also lie in his successful fusion of Venetian color traditions with artistic concepts from other Italian regions. In popular culture, Titian's works are frequently referenced and imitated, and his color theories have influenced countless later painters. Titian's career spanned the high and late Renaissance, witnessing the evolution of artistic styles, making his works important materials for studying the artistic development of this period. Despite controversies, Titian's position in Western art history is undisputed, and his works remain significant subjects for art research and appreciation.

self.zh: 色彩是我的主要追求，因为色彩能够直接触动心灵。
self.en: Color is my main preoccupation, for color can directly touch the soul.

others.zh: 提香是所有时代的画家中最伟大的，因为他拥有最丰富的色彩天赋和最完美的技巧。
others.en: Titian is the greatest of all painters of all ages, for he had the most rich color talent and the most perfect technique.
